title: vx init --dry --format json
description: What vx init (or vx-migrate) would write, nothing written. In a Turbo or Nx repo the plan is vx-migrate's.

source.description: what the plan maps: package.json scripts, turbo.json, nx graph, lerna.json …

files.description: each file the run would write, root-relative, with its whole text

replaced.description: files of another extension the run would delete for the new ones

next.description: the command to type after the real run; null where the plan names none
